py0q7fkb.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
py0q7fkb.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 8ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 8ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 8ft • 700 professionally hand strung multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 3554 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 160cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

nx3ptxm9.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - Green - 150 cm
nx3ptxm9.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - Green - 150 cm
nx3ptxm9.sourceDescription: This decorative LED string light is designed to elevate your home environment with a touch of modern elegance. Emitting a warm, soft glow, it’s an aesthetically pleasing addition to any setting, whether used to adorn your living room, garden, or terrace. The cone-shaped design, paired with its vibrant green hue, ensures that the string light both complements and enhances the festive ambiance during special occasions like Christmas. Materials: Constructed from PVC, this string light blends durability with flexibility, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings. The steel components enhance its robustness, ensuring it withstands seasonal use while maintaining its structural integrity. The materials chosen guarantee a long-lasting decorative appeal without compromising on the modern aesthetic. Included Components: The set features LED decorative string lights that bring a warm white illumination to any space. The lights are USB-powered, which adds convenience, allowing for easy connectivity and versatility in positioning. This feature ensures users enjoy a seamless and energy-efficient lighting experience for any occasion. Features /Function /Design: Notable for its decorative design, the string light flaunts a modern aesthetic with clean, minimalistic lines. The USB functionality broadens its adaptability, making it easy to integrate into existing decor or for seasonal embellishments. This thoughtful design enhances the user experience with practicality and style. Recommended Uses: The lights are ideal for use in living rooms, gardens, and terraces, where they add warmth and festivity. Whether used for family gatherings or quiet evenings, the lights create a soothing ambiance tailored for enjoyment and relaxation. Care &Maintenance: To ensure longevity, follow the assembly instructions carefully. The USB connection should be handled with care, and lights should be stored in a dry place when not in use to maintain their quality. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,20x3cmball,21x4cmball,20x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

n1pq11m6.baseName: My Christmas 6ft Artificial Black Christmas Tree with 800 Tips - Black
n1pq11m6.variantName: My Christmas 6ft Artificial Black Christmas Tree with 800 Tips - Black
n1pq11m6.sourceDescription: Create a striking festive display with this 6ft black artificial Christmas tree, featuring 800 PVC tips for a full, layered appearance. Its bold black colour offers a modern alternative to traditional Christmas trees, making it suitable for both Halloween decorations and Christmas celebrations. The flexible branches can be spread and shaped to achieve a fuller look, ready for your favourite lights and decorations. The tree comes in three hinged sections for straightforward assembly and is supplied with a sturdy black metal stand featuring fold-out legs for reliable support. Designed for repeated seasonal use, it provides a practical and reusable decoration for your home. Specifications: Made from PVC with 800 branch tips. Features three hinged sections, flexible adjustable branches and a black metal stand with fold-out legs. Reusable design suitable for Halloween and Christmas decorations. Dimensions: Height 6ft (approximately 183cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
